Inbound via self-serve signup (trial) — early-stage code-assistant startup. Short notes from call 2026-02-15: 
- Product: in-editor code assistant (VSCode/JetBrains) + command palette completions.
- Main asks: support long context (>50k tokens) for whole-file/fuzzy search, stable streaming for incremental completions, and per-org higher rate limits for peak usage.
- SDK: wants official Go + Rust SDKs (Node is OK but they prefer polyglot client libs).
- Security: SOC2 required for later contract; immediate ask for SSO/SAML + audit logs + KMS guidance.
- Pricing sensitivity: SMB budget, prefers usage-based + predictable caps; asked about burst/overage behavior.
- Quote from founder: "we need predictable latency under 200ms for single-line completions and ability to attach 20–50k tokens context for suggestion accuracy".
- Wants lightweight onboarding: sample prompts, rate-limit guide, token accounting in SDK.
- Has ~1200 signups in alpha list; concerns about scaling beyond self-serve.
- Requested drive pricing deck + security FAQ (AE to send).
